newsitem.title: UK: Kenwood shares rise on stakebuilding report.
newsitem.headline: Kenwood shares rise on stakebuilding report.

text.p: Shares in Kenwood Appliances Plc rose on Monday after a Sunday Telegraph report that two dissident shareholders planned to shake up the manufacturer of food mixers and other appliances.
The stock was up 13p at 220-1/2 by 1020 GMT.

The paper said shareholder Julian Treger is understood to already have met Kenwood's chief executive Tim Beech, who has been under pressure from shareholders after Kenwood issued a profit warning at its annual meeting on August 9.
Treger and Brian Myerson, the other dissident shareholder, have built up a 7.74 percent stake in Kenwood in the past six weeks, the Telegraph said.
No-one at the company was immediately available for comment.
